messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — ATS export for yesterday's onboarding batch dropped the privacy/confidential flag on a bunch of eval forms. Noticed when prepping interviewer checklists; some rows have privacy_tag empty. Holding off sending external interviewers these checklists.

Chris (Recruiter): Ugh. I ran the standard CSV export and saw privacy_tag blanks too. We changed the mapping last week (private_note -> privacy_tag) — maybe the connector didn't pick it up.

Devin (Hiring Ops): Can you paste the header + a sample row? makes it easier to run a quick diff.

Maya (People Ops): Sure — excerpt from the export (sanitized):

```csv
candidate_id,role,interviewer,private_note,privacy_tag,eval_url
12345,Backend Engineer,Julia,"Follow up on perf test",,https://hr/reviews/12345
12346,PM,Alex,"travel restricted",,https://hr/reviews/12346
```

Chris (Recruiter): That's consistent. Header shows both private_note and privacy_tag but privacy_tag empty. Connector config was edited in PR #912 — maybe deploy failed.

Julia (Eng Manager): Is this the same mapping issue we saw in Q4? That one was a deploy race where the connector restarted before the new schema was live.

Chris (Recruiter): Possible. Quick check command: `curl -sS https://internal-connector/api/v1/mapping | jq .fields` — returns the active mapping. I can run it now if someone confirms.

ats-bot: Connector health check — 1719123670 — ERROR: export-mapper service returned 503 for /api/v1/mapping (uptime 2m, restarted).

Devin (Hiring Ops): OK plan: 1) Hold external checklist sends (Maya) 2) Chris, confirm mapping in config and whether latest deploy completed 3) I'll run a backfill to populate privacy_tag from private_note for affected exports and post results.

Chris (Recruiter): Confirmed backup exists: s3://redwood-hr-backups/exports/2026-03-22.csv. I'll check the mapping now and revert to previous mapping if needed.

Maya (People Ops): Important — note in case: interviewer checklists hide candidate PII when privacy_tag == "confidential". Until backfill/deploy done, we should not share with vendors/external interviewers.

Julia (Eng Manager): I'll pause invites for the candidate batch that uses external interviewers. Scheduling a 30-min follow-up postmortem tomorrow 10:30 PT — inviter: julia@redwood.com.

Devin (Hiring Ops): Running backfill (dry-run) now: `python scripts/backfill_privacy_tag.py --file s3://redwood-hr-backups/exports/2026-03-22.csv --dry-run`

Devin (Hiring Ops): Dry-run results: would update 42 rows (privacy_tag -> 'confidential' when private_note non-empty). Looks safe.

Chris (Recruiter): Mapping in the connector UI shows the rename applied but service restarted midway through deploy (see logs). I'm going to re-deploy mapping change and watch the health endpoint.

ats-bot: Deploy event 1719123785 — export-mapper v2.14 deployed by chris@redwood.com. Health check OK after 45s.

Devin (Hiring Ops): Running backfill (live): `python scripts/backfill_privacy_tag.py --file s3://redwood-hr-backups/exports/2026-03-22.csv --apply`

Devin (Hiring Ops): Backfill complete — 42 rows updated. Uploaded new export to s3://redwood-hr-backups/exports/2026-03-22-postbackfill.csv and notified SRE for long-term fix verification.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll resume external checklist sends for the affected batch and follow up with candidate ops email template update (callout about confidentiality flag).

Julia (Eng Manager): Please add a short postmortem note to the onboarding-ops board: root cause = mapping deploy race; fix = add pre-deploy health gating + do-not-serve flag during mapping swaps.

Chris (Recruiter): Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Closing the thread. If anything else pops up, ping this thread or @deven-ops.
